exposure: Cases (women who underwent emergency peripartum hysterectomy)
Controls (women who did not undergo hysterectomy)
cohort: 394 women who gave birth (61 cases and 333 controls)
finding: Severe postpartum hemorrhage, previous cesarean section, and uterine atony were significantly associated with emergency peripartum hysterectomy.
mod_finding: Emergency peripartum hysterectomy was associated with previous cesarean section.
